newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, NYMEX up after overnight slump.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, NYMEX up after overnight slump.

text.p: Brent crude futures, which slumped overnight, were untraded at midday in Asia on Wednesday but indicated steady after an uptick in NYMEX prices.
July Brent was quoted at $19.18/$19.25 per barrel on SIMEX, around the London close overnight of $19.22.
Global futures prices slumped overnight on perception the market was net long and heavy with speculative positions.
London dropped 78 cents and NYMEX July futures fell 84 to $20.79.
Brokers said they expected Asia to be cautious about continuing the sell off and would wait for direction from London.
However, NYMEX trading on ACCESS was offering some support.
July pared New York's losses by five cents to last trade at $20.84, while August cut back the losses 10 cents to last trade at $20.94.
